pages.text: $(bold)Tier 1 Materials$()$(br2)Iron · Copper · Brass (Create) · Tin · Bronze$(br2)$(bold)What's absent:$() Diamonds have been removed from Overworld worldgen and all Overworld structure chests. Steel requires Thermal Series (Tier 2). Netherite requires the Nether (Tier 3).$(br2)Your Tier 1 ceiling is a finely crafted bronze or brass weapon/armor set with Common Apotheosis affixes.

$(bold)Materials Are Tokens$()$(br2)The Engineering and Magic lanes turn your production into progression. Submit it to the Codex (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)).$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Engineering:$() bulk metals plus milestone machines — Create at T1, Thermal at T2, Mekanism at T3.$(li)$(bold)Magic:$() cultivation reagents plus apparatus — Botania at T1, Ars Nouveau at T2, advanced rituals at T3.

$(bold)Every Material Is Capped$()$(br2)Each material banks tokens only up to its cap, so a pure builder or cultivator reaches the threshold by working the whole tier's list — not by spamming one resource.$(br2)Run $(bold)/icraft codex balance$() to see which caps you've already filled.

$(bold)Tier 2 Materials$()$(br2)Steel (Thermal) · Manasteel (Botania) · Signalum · Lumium · Steeleaf · Ironwood · Fiery (Twilight Forest)$(br2)$(bold)Diamonds:$() still Tier 3 — not yet craftable or mineable. Twilight bosses may drop small amounts as a bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Apotheosis:$() Uncommon + Rare affixes, 2 sockets, Chipped/Normal gems.

$(bold)Tier 3 Materials$()$(br2)Diamond (full access) · Terrasteel · Elementium · Enderium · Osmium · Refined Obsidian$(br2)$(bold)Tier 4 Materials$()$(br2)Netherite · Gaia Ingots · Dragon Scales/Hearts · Antimatter · Atomic Alloy$(br2)$(bold)Boss materials$() are unique crafting components dropped by specific bosses. They are $(italic)spoils$() — they power high-end recipes, but they are never progression currency. See $(l:icraft:progression/tier_skip)Spoils Aren't Currency$(/l).
